text:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源), DAPI / Hoechst / PI]
**Justification:** FDISCO (fluorescence-preserving DISCO) is selected for its exceptional ability to preserve endogenous fluorescence (e.g., GFP) while achieving high transparency in whole adult mouse brains. By utilizing pH-adjusted (pH 9.0) THF for dehydration and BABB-Df for clearing at a low temperature (4 ℃), it effectively maintains the structural integrity and signal intensity of fine neuronal processes like axons and dendrites, which is essential for 3D morphological mapping. DAPI is included to provide a reference for cell body distribution.
**Protocol Steps:**
1 Nuclear Staining
Incubation with DAPI (10 μg/ml) in 0.01M PBS for nuclear labeling of cell bodies.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
Dehydration and Delipidation
Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
Incubation with 95% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) peroxide-free THF (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
Incubation with a fresh second batch of 100% (vol/vol) peroxide-free THF (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
RI Matching and Clearing
Incubation with BABB-Df (BABB:Diphenyl ether = 1:1, pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine) for refractive index matching and final clearing. BABB is prepared by mixing Benzyl alcohol and Benzyl benzoate in a 1:2 ratio.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
